name: osu-daily-tracker-app
description: Android shell for osu! Daily Tracker

scripts.build: esbuild native-bridge.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=www/native-bridge.bundle.js && esbuild mania-converter.mjs --bundle --format=iife --outfile=www/mania-converter.bundle.js && esbuild replay-renderer-adapter.mjs --bundle --format=iife --global-name=OsuReplayRenderer --outfile=www/replay-renderer.bundle.js
scripts.test: npm run test:replay-inline && npm run test:mania-key-remap && npm run test:standard-mania-conversion && npm run test:renderer-adapter && npm run test:renderer-adapter
